feeds.title: Nature » Cervical cancer
feeds.description: Cervical cancer is a disease in which the cells of the cervix become abnormal and start to grow uncontrollably. Approximately 90% are squamous cell carcinomas, and the remaining 10% are adenocarcinomas. This cancer originates in the mucus-producing cells of the inner or endocervix, near the body of the uterus.
